rationale: SqliteConnection::lock_handle returns Result<LockedSqliteHandle<'_>, Error>, so conn.lock_handle().await?.set_commit_hook(...) in the sqlite integration tests calls this method. The miss is chained awaited/try return-type inference, which no in-scope Rust rule covers.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The prior fp-novel verdict is correct and cites a real caller.
